docs.title: AI Impact Library
docs.text:
Welcome to the AI Impact Library.

A structured repository mapping the impacts of Artificial Intelligence across society.

docs.title: Mission
docs.text:
The goal of this library is to create a comprehensive map of how AI changes the world.

PROVAA

docs.title: Vision
docs.text: The AI Impact Library is a structured knowledge base mapping the consequences of Artificial Intelligence across society.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
The project aims to document:

  • Opportunities created by AI
  • Risks introduced by AI
  • Ethical considerations
  • Stakeholders affected
  • Evidence supporting each impact

docs.title: Methodology
docs.text:
Each AI impact is documented using a standardized framework including:

  • AI capability
  • Ethical dimensions
  • Polarity
  • Stakeholders
  • Benefits
  • Risks
  • Evidence
  • References
